title: Nexus CoreTimelineEventsQuery
description: Owned query for one World's timeline events. Branch defaults to the World's current branch; status defaults to canon; cursor is a bounded opaque keyset over (branch_id, sequence_no).

branch_id.description: Fork branch filter; defaults to the World's current branch (fbk_root fallback).

status.description: Event status filter; defaults to canon.

limit.description: Page size bound; server applies its default page size when omitted.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous page.
